authors.bio: Michael Racelo received his B.S.E.E. from the University of Hawaii in 1970 and his M.S.E.E. from the University of California, Santa Barbara in 1975. He has been developing and designing hardware and software for missile guidance systems, digital electronic instruments and video editing systems since 1971. With EECO Inc., since early 1981, he has worked on the company's line of computer controls for video production, particularly as project engineer for EECO's VIG-850 and VIR-950 VITC products. Presently, he is involved in developing interfaces for EECO's new intelligent video editing system-IVES.
